The first release of **loop-island**: a Dynamic Island for Windows and Linux.

### Downloads
- **loop-island.exe**: the app for Windows 10/11. Download it and run it.
- **loop-island-win64-linux.zip**: the exe plus the Linux launcher (`./loop-island --install`, needs Wine 8+).
- **Source code**: zip / tar.gz below.

### Highlights
- **Adaptive color:** the island picks up a tinted edge and glow on dark wallpapers and stays solid black on light ones.
- **Lagoon theme:** a teal accent and a Midnight card.
- **Smoother motion:** frames are synced to your display's refresh rate, and drawing is faster.
- **Little animations:** hover, press and toggles ease in and out, and the island pulses gently when Claude Code is waiting.
- **Linux via Wine:** the launcher installs it to your app menu and can start it at login.

The exe isn't signed, so on first run choose **More info › Run anyway** when SmartScreen asks.
